wedding.title: Wedding
wedding.heroDescription: Complete floral styling to make your day truly magical
wedding.about: At MOISIS Flower Design, we take care of every floral detail for your wedding. From the bridal bouquet to the church and reception decor, every element is designed with love and precision. Harris works closely with you to bring your dream atmosphere to life, using only the freshest and most exquisite flowers.

christening.title: Christenings
christening.heroDescription: Flowers that make the christening unforgettable
christening.about: We create unique floral arrangements for christenings that blend the joy of the moment with the elegance of fresh flowers. From soft pastels to bolder palettes, we tailor every creation to match the style and theme of your celebration.

graduation.title: Graduation
graduation.about: Graduation is a milestone that deserves to be celebrated with the most beautiful flowers. We create elegant bouquets and arrangements that express the pride and joy of this special day.

corporate.title: Corporate
corporate.heroDescription: Professional floral styling for every business need
corporate.about: We handle floral design for corporate events, conferences, grand openings, and office spaces. With professionalism and a refined aesthetic, we create arrangements that elevate any environment and impress your guests.
